work.title: Untitled (Cassette Torso)
work.description: Two joined cardboard panels shaped into a rough torso silhouette, densely layered with cassette tape components, gold compact discs, soccer balls, ribbon stripes, paper ephemera, and a sequined heart motif. Red and orange vertical ribbon stripes punctuate the composition alongside scattered printed tickets, stickers, and circular disc elements.
work.composition: torso-shaped panels densely layered with ephemera
keywords: gold disc and ribbon stripe collage
